content: With 2026 delivering a packed release schedule for Magic: The Gathering exploring classic planes and several Universes Beyond crossovers, Commander players have had plenty of exciting new legends to build around. From returning to familiar fantasy worlds in sets like Lorwyn Eclipsed and Secrets of Strixhaven to epic crossovers like Marvel Super Heroes, The Hobbit, and Star Trek, the year brought an unprecedented wave of Commanders for casual and competitive tables alike.
